verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a REST API reference with documented endpoint schemas, serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and includes runnable curl/Python/JavaScript examples in the quickstart and capability guides. Nothing shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console that executes requests. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs request explorer/playground, evidence that reference pages themselves embed executable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The xAI REST API is compatible with the OpenAI REST API.
GET /v1/models — List all models available to the authenticating API key, including model names (ID), creation times, and pricing
followed by a runnable first request (curl/Python/JavaScript) in the same guide
